BOHJ18A3 - Behandling med adalimumab is a clinical treatment code used within the Danish Inflammatory Bowel Disease database (DANIBD) to register treatments involving adalimumab, an anti-TNF biologic medication. In the context of national quality monitoring for IBD care, this code is essential for tracking the usage of [[bmsl|Biologiske og målrettede syntetiske lægemidler]] (biological and targeted synthetic drugs), which is a key focus of quality indicator 5 in the DANIBD annual reports [^src2].

During the period from October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023, adalimumab (BOHJ18A3) was the second most frequently used BMSL treatment among both children and adults [^src1]. Specifically, it was administered to 59 children and adolescents (16%) and 2,689 adults (26%) during this timeframe [^src1]. 

The ongoing tracking of this treatment code across subsequent reports, such as the 2024 DANIBD report, continues to provide detailed quantitative data on patient characteristics, treatment frequencies, and drug distribution [^src2]. This data forms the foundation for clinical benchmarking, evaluating treatment access, and developing evidence-based treatment guidelines for IBD patients in Denmark [^src2].
